cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
if(CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR STREQUAL CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR)
    project(PermafrostBenchmark LANGUAGES C)
    enable_testing()
    set(ILAND_BUILD_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../../build-msvc-release" CACHE PATH "Existing project build")
    find_library(ILAND_LIBRARY NAMES ILandModel PATHS "${ILAND_BUILD_DIR}/3rdparty/iland-model/src" REQUIRED)
    add_library(ILandModel SHARED IMPORTED)
    if(WIN32)
        find_file(ILAND_RUNTIME NAMES ILandModel.dll PATHS "${ILAND_BUILD_DIR}/3rdparty/iland-model/src" REQUIRED)
        set_target_properties(ILandModel PROPERTIES IMPORTED_IMPLIB "${ILAND_LIBRARY}" IMPORTED_LOCATION "${ILAND_RUNTIME}")
    else()
        set_target_properties(ILandModel PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${ILAND_LIBRARY}")
    endif()
    add_library(sqlite3 STATIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../sqlite/sqlite3.c")
    target_include_directories(sqlite3 PUBLIC "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../sqlite")
    if(UNIX)
        find_package(Threads REQUIRED)
        target_link_libraries(sqlite3 PUBLIC Threads::Threads ${CMAKE_DL_LIBS} m)
    endif()
endif()
add_executable(iland-permafrost-benchmark benchmark.c)
target_include_directories(iland-permafrost-benchmark PRIVATE "../../src")
target_link_libraries(iland-permafrost-benchmark PRIVATE ILandModel sqlite3)
if(UNIX)
    target_link_libraries(iland-permafrost-benchmark PRIVATE m)
endif()
configure_file(prepare.cmake.in prepare.cmake @ONLY)
add_custom_target(iland-permafrost-inputs
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/prepare.cmake")
if(WIN32)
    add_custom_command(TARGET iland-permafrost-inputs POST_BUILD
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:iland-permafrost-benchmark>"
        COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different "$<TARGET_FILE:ILandModel>" "$<TARGET_FILE_DIR:iland-permafrost-benchmark>" VERBATIM)
    add_dependencies(iland-permafrost-inputs ILandModel)
endif()
add_dependencies(iland-permafrost-benchmark iland-permafrost-inputs)
add_test(NAME permafrost-prepare COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/prepare.cmake")
set_tests_properties(permafrost-prepare PROPERTIES FIXTURES_SETUP permafrost-inputs)
add_test(NAME permafrost-borehole-benchmark COMMAND iland-permafrost-benchmark "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/model")
set_tests_properties(permafrost-borehole-benchmark PROPERTIES
    WORKING_DIRECTORY "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/run"
    FIXTURES_REQUIRED permafrost-inputs TIMEOUT 180)
